author: Spartemex
body:
Hey Guys!

I'm sorry to say that I'm closing my build server. It was just too expensive. If you need any of the maps, please use the link below.

Here is all the server's files. I'd prefer you'd get the maps from here: http://www.mediafire.com/?aqmvwmyhb9pj8

replies.author: TurkishDelite
replies.body:
single player is easier because:
1) there's less of a hassle to get the map download (for me at least) so you can release the download straight away
2) there's less crashes and spikes when world editing (depending on pc hardware, but i have a 10+ year old pc so it should be fine)
3) you can have access to more commands maybe since you have control of anything you want

idk what you mean by getting less feedback by going with SP compared to MP, do you mean you get instant feedback by people on the build server? if so what i do is just go on teamspeak have normal conversations and ask people for feedback by giving them some snapshots of the map
